title: Quietly Velvety Irish Mozzarella Tagine
description: A kid-friendly Irish dish featuring mozzarella balls cooked in a tagine with floral and velvety flavors, following ayurvedic-sattvic principles.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped onion, garlic, carrots, and potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper until they are evenly coated.
Transfer the vegetable mixture to a tagine or a large Dutch oven.
Add the chicken broth, dried thyme, and mozzarella balls to the tagine.
Cover the tagine with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and the mozzarella is melted and creamy.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Quietly Velvety Irish Mozzarella Tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
